Ask the provider to open the ID in their phone wallet. Tap the two phones together, or scan the QR code the wallet shows. The provider approves the request on their phone.

That QR code isn\'t a mobile ID engagement code (it should start with \"mdoc:\").
Hold the two phones back to back until \"Connect by NFC\" shows ✓, then you can separate them while the provider approves.
The reader needs Nearby devices (Bluetooth) access to receive the ID, and the camera for QR. Allow them in Settings to continue.
This phone has no NFC. Use the QR code option.
Turn on NFC, then try again.

The phones lost contact. Hold them back to back and keep them still until all steps finish, then try again.
